name: ghost-poc-hermes-tool-policy
description: Suggested allow/deny boundaries when pointing Nous Hermes Agent (or similar tool-using LLM agents) at the GHOST PoC repository. Adapt to your org's Hermes tool config format.
ghost_invariants: agents/watcher.py must not define DETECTABLE_PATTERNS inline; import from skills.watcher_skills
agents/healer.py must not define DECISION_TABLE inline; import from skills.healer_skills
agents/k8s_watcher.py must import rules only from skills.k8s_signal_skills
service name app-service in simulator and scenarios unless spec explicitly changes
